description: This file defines backbone modules for an object detection model, including custom BatchNorm, backbone classes, and a backbone builder function.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone networks, managing layer freezing and intermediate layer extraction.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable via parameters.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, producing nested tensors and positional encodings.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Constructs a backbone model with position encoding based on provided arguments.
